# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# Training environment for DN-MOPD (teachers, students, SeqKD-SFT, merges, HF export).
# Python 3.12, Linux x86_64, NVIDIA GPU with a CUDA 13.0-capable driver.
#
# These are the top-level packages of the environment that produced the paper's checkpoints, pinned to the exact
# versions that were installed. Every pin resolves from public PyPI, except that the three PyTorch wheels should come
# from the PyTorch CUDA 13.0 index (see env/install.md, step 2):
#
#   pip install --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130 \
#       torch==2.11.0 torchvision==0.26.0 torchaudio==2.11.0
#   pip install -r env/requirements-train.txt -c env/constraints-train.txt
#
# The pins below match the already installed "+cu130" wheels (a local version label is ignored when matching).
# env/constraints-train.txt is the full frozen package list of the paper's environment and keeps every transitive
# dependency at the version used in the paper.
#
# NOT installed from this file:
#   * miles (this repository's fork, ./miles)       -> pip install -e ./miles --no-deps
#   * dn_mopd (this repository's package, ./)       -> pip install -e .
#   Do NOT "pip install miles": the unrelated PyPI project of that name is not the trainer.

# ---- PyTorch (CUDA 13.0 build; install first from the PyTorch index) ----
torch==2.11.0
torchvision==0.26.0
torchaudio==2.11.0
triton==3.6.0

# ---- Rollout engine and teacher servers ----
# The paper installed SGLang v0.5.15.post1 in editable mode from git (tag v0.5.15.post1, commit 0b3bb0cbe3, no local
# patches). The PyPI wheel below is built from the same release and declares the same core dependencies.
sglang==0.5.15.post1
sglang-kernel==0.4.4
sglang-router==0.3.2
flashinfer-python==0.6.12
flashinfer-cubin==0.6.12
# FlashAttention-4 is a pre-release on PyPI; the exact pin lets pip select it without --pre.
flash-attn-4==4.0.0b15
flash-linear-attention==0.5.2
fla-core==0.5.2
torch_memory_saver==0.0.9.post1
xgrammar==0.2.1
cuda-python==13.1.0

# ---- Trainer (miles, FSDP backend; no Megatron-LM, TransformerEngine or apex) ----
transformers==5.12.1
tokenizers==0.22.2
huggingface_hub==1.26.0
safetensors==0.8.0
accelerate==1.14.0
ray[default]==2.56.1
numpy==2.3.5
ring-flash-attn==0.1.8
datasets==5.0.1
omegaconf==2.3.1
pybase64==1.4.3
blobfile==3.0.0
httpx[http2]==0.28.1
pillow==11.3.0
PyYAML==6.0.1
qwen-vl-utils==0.0.14
pylatexenc==2.11
mcp[cli]==2.0.0

tensorboard==2.20.0
wandb==0.26.1

# ---- Rewards and graders used during training ----
math-verify==0.9.0

uvicorn==0.46.0

# ---- Tests ----
